summary.name: b1gMail
summary.one_liner: b1gMail is a self-hostable, GPL-licensed email server and webmail suite that lets you run your own email service for users or an organization.
use_cases: run an email service for users or an organization
host email addresses on shared web hosting
filter and scan incoming email for spam and viruses
manage many email accounts from an admin panel
summary.what_it_does: b1gMail is a complete email solution that runs on standard web space with PHP and MariaDB, and it can be used to become an email service provider. It offers a user webmail interface with HTML5 drag and drop, plus address book, calendar, notes, tasks, cloud drive, SMS and fax features. Administrators get a web-based Administration Control Panel with a setup wizard and plugin installation. Email handling includes smart folders based on user-defined criteria, filter rules that reply, notify by SMS, move or flag messages, DNSBL and Bayesian spam filtering, and a ClamAV interface for virus scanning. The page states it can be used with POP3 catchall mailboxes and integrated with Postfix or b1gMailServer.
notable: Since version 7.4.1 licensed under GPL with proprietary components removed
Runs on shared web space without a dedicated server for most features
Plugin interface that survives product updates
Smart folders and user-defined filter rules
caveats: Earlier versions from version 6 were commercial; the page describes the GPL change only from 7.4.1 onward
Postfix or b1gMailServer integration is needed for running your own mail server, per the listing
